description: Every Agent in a segment's close records or archived txs: established, grader, Score (POAScan's own, 0 to 100), rewards in the segment, last paid close, eligible closes, seals and attestations. sort is score, rewards, eligible, seals or atts (highest first); filter is established, graders or attesters. CSV at /api/v1/governance/directory.csv. Use it to list or rank all Agents in a segment.

dir.description: desc (default: the key's natural order, highest first for numbers, A to Z for names, fewest closes left first for left, a level in its order) or asc (reversed); blanks last either way

filter.description: established, graders, attesters or empty for all

limit.description: maximum Agents to return (1 to 5000, default 100)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

sort.description: rewards (default), eligible, seals, atts, score or a Score part, name (A to Z) or last_paid

name: list_governance_directory
title: Agent directory
